name: App Shell
description: Root application orchestrator. Creates CanvasArea and TopBar, manages workspace lifecycle (CLI path resolution, WelcomeModal fallback, workspace load/save), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+N new window, Ctrl+W prevention, Ctrl+Tab card cycling, Ctrl+P file search, Ctrl+J new terminal), auto-save with debounced JSON diff comparison, reloads user preferences (theme, grid style, zoom lock (with workspace state fallback), tutorial), initializes window control buttons (minimize/maximize/close).

dependencies.usage: Creates and owns CanvasArea instance, wires state change and plugin change callbacks
Creates TopBar with full callback object (19 handlers) for menus, buttons, zoom, theme, grid
Shown as fallback when no CLI workspace path is provided
Opened via Help > About, locks canvas during display
Started on first workspace load if showTutorial preference is not false
Reads/sets dark/light preference on startup and toggle

shortcuts.action: Cycle canvas cards forward/backward (reverse with Shift)
Open file search palette on active explorer
Create new terminal card at workspace root

state.lastSaved: string — JSON.stringify'd SaveState for diff-based auto-save
state.auto_save: Debounced via onStateChange callback → JSON diff → IPC workspace:save
